text:
rebuild the entire tracker system to use novig api wallet data. erase what it already shows because it may be wrong. 
1) erase tracker data as it is now, but keep clv/EV data as a file on GitHub that the app tracker can read
2) wire the tracker to get all historical wallet data including bets, bids, both from the engine and hand, daily profit and loss, total profit and loss. basically get all the data novig has on the wallet as far back as it goes. 
3) from here on, have github and novig supply the information for the tracker as much as possible and as accurately as possible. have the app tracker only do the leftover work such as tracking clv, EV, time placed, hand bets, etc. upload this information to be saved on github instead of building up on the phone. 
4) the tracker in the app should look and function the same, including charts, but the data should be synced from and to github. the profit calculations should come from data from novig, stored on github. 
5) make the app efficient by caching all tracker information and save it to phone storage for offline viewing, and when I pull down to refresh or press a refresh button, it only updates the newer missing information from novig and github and syncs it to the phone storage and app. the app doesn't need a full read every time because every refresh will cache and store new data, so future refreshes only need the data since the last refresh. 

build this now and release it without delay
